reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Sleeping Pack 100mL
reviews.text: This was one of the first products I tried from SKIN1004 and I am truly impressed. It’s a thick gel texture but after 10 minutes it soaks into the skin and feels like a lightweight cream. This is fantastic after a long flight when the skin feels truly parched. I like to also use it after a sheet mask so it locks in all the moisture. On my sensitive skin it does not irritate it however for others with sensitive skin, I do recommend doing a patch test before putting it all over the face!
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第一次試 SKIN1004 嘅產品之一，我真心覺得非常驚喜。佢係濃稠嘅 gel 狀質地，但 10 分鐘之後就會被皮膚吸收，摸落似輕盈嘅乳霜。坐完長途機皮膚勁缺水嘅時候用，簡直一流。我鍾意喺敷完面膜之後再用，咁可以將所有水分鎖住。喺我嘅敏感肌上面用都唔會刺激，不過如果其他敏感肌嘅朋友，我都建議喺全面使用之前先做個局部測試！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Sleeping Pack 100mL
reviews.text:
I’ve been using the SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica product for a few weeks now, and I’m genuinely impressed with how well it performs, especially for hydration and soothing. My skin tends to be sensitive and easily dehydrated, so I’m always looking for products that can provide moisture without feeling heavy or irritating. This one has fit very nicely into my routine.

First, the packaging is clean, minimal, and very typical of SKIN1004’s aesthetic. It looks simple but high quality. The tube/bottle design is practical and easy to use daily without any mess. I also like that it feels hygienic and travel-friendly, which is always a plus for me.

The texture is one of the standout features. It has a lightweight, smooth consistency that spreads effortlessly on the skin. It doesn’t feel thick or sticky at all. When I apply it, it glides easily and absorbs faster than many hydrating products I’ve tried. This makes it very comfortable for both morning and nighttime routines.

As soon
reviews.zh:
我已經用咗 SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica 嘅產品幾個星期，佢嘅表現真係令我很驚喜，尤其係保濕同舒緩方面。我嘅皮膚偏向敏感肌而且容易缺水，所以我一直喺搵可以提供滋潤但又唔會厚重或者刺激嘅產品。呢枝就好順利咁融入咗我嘅護膚程序。

首先，包裝簡潔、minimal，完全係 SKIN1004 一貫嘅風格。睇落簡單但有高級感。支裝／瓶裝嘅設計實用，每日用都好方便，完全唔會整到周圍都係。我亦都鍾意佢感覺乾淨衛生，而且方便帶去旅行，對我嚟講呢點好加分。

質地係佢最突出嘅賣點之一。佢質地輕盈滑順，可以毫不費力咁推開。完全唔會厚重或者黏笠。搽嘅時候好滑，仲要比我用過嘅好多保濕產品吸收得更快。呢一點令佢無論喺朝早定夜晚嘅護膚程序都用得好舒服。

正當
